title: fix(gitops): serialize applies in the GitLab CI template

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1 @@
+- Fixed the GitOps GitLab CI template so overlapping applies (push and scheduled pipelines) run one at a time via a `resource_group`, matching the GitHub workflow's `concurrency` group.

@@ -1,5 +1,7 @@
 fleet-gitops:
   image: debian:bookworm-slim
+  # Prevent concurrent applies: a slower, older run could otherwise finish last and roll back newer changes.
+  resource_group: fleet-gitops
   variables:
     FLEET_DRY_RUN_ONLY: true
   rules:
